customers.evidence: Since 1850, American Express has worked to make a difference in our customers' lives in ways that matter most to them.

employees.evidence: we bring the powerful backing of American Express to our customers, colleagues and communities

community.evidence: Community Giving from the American Express Foundation

result.analyst_notes: Promotional, aspirational tone with heavy use of 'powerful backing' language. Customers are addressed first, with colleagues and communities following in a single list. Voice is first-person plural ('our'). Commitments are general and unhedged ('worked to make a difference'), with few concrete measures. Much of the text is navigation or call-to-action chrome, leaving little developed value content.
